Ember Reach sits where the silt used to steam at dusk. The streets are packed clay. The houses are [[Kiln-Houses|kiln-houses]], low and round-shouldered, with doorways that face the old channel as if the river might still come to supper.

[[Riverfolk]] built the town in 780 AR. They moored barges at the willow docks and fired bricks in the same ovens they used for bread. After [[The River Runs Dry]], the docks became a walkway over cracked mud.

The [[The Ashwardens|Ashwardens]] keep a lodge on the west rise. [[Mira Vale]] rents a room near the market and sells copies of her survey to people who want to remember where their gardens used to drink.
